product_one_liner.value: Octopus Deploy is a continuous delivery platform that automates release orchestration, application deployments, and operational runbooks for software teams.
product_one_liner.notes: https://octopus.com/docs describes Octopus as a continuous delivery platform for modern software teams, providing release orchestration, deployment automation, and runbook automation.

pricing_page.notes: https://octopus.com/pricing is a public pricing page and includes a displayed annual USD price.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Octopus homepage content retrieved at http://octopus.com/company/careers/4000924201 displays Starbucks and PayPal in its 'Trusted by over 4,000 organizations' customer logo wall. | named_customers.0: The Octopus homepage content at http://octopus.com/company/careers/4000924201 includes Starbucks in its customer logo wall. | named_customers.1: The Octopus homepage content at http://octopus.com/company/careers/4000924201 includes PayPal in its customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: https://linkedin.com/company/octopus-deploy reports 328 employees, which falls within the requested 201-500 band. Profile-based headcounts can differ from payroll counts.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: https://dealroom.co/companies/octopus-com explicitly identifies Brisbane as the headquarters city. https://octopus.com/contact gives the more specific office location in South Brisbane. | hq_country: https://dealroom.co/companies/octopus-com identifies the headquarters as Brisbane, Australia; https://octopus.com/contact provides the Australian office address.

founded_year.notes: https://octopus.com/company explicitly states that Paul and Sonia Stovell founded Octopus Deploy in 2012. This primary-source date is preferred over a conflicting third-party listing.

eng_blog.notes: https://octopus.com/blog/tag/engineering includes at least two substantive posts about building Octopus: Pawel Pabich's cloud-architecture article and Andrew Best's target-architecture article. Pabich describes the team's own system-design work at https://octopus.com/blog/octopus-cloud-architecture; https://octopus.com/company identifies Best as CTO and engineering leader. Pabich's engineering involvement is supported by his firsthand account rather than an explicit job-title biography.

public_docs.notes: https://octopus.com/docs provides public product documentation. Its getting-started guide at https://octopus.com/docs/getting-started links to multiple articles, including installation, projects, deployment processes, variables, infrastructure, and runbooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/octopusdeploy lists five current openings: two Revenue Systems Specialist roles and three regional expressions of interest. None has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: https://octopus.com/docs/octopus-ai.md says the Claude Agent Step runs Claude Code and requires the customer's own Anthropic API key; customers choose the model.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: https://trust.octopus.com/ publicly lists SOC 2, ISO 27001:2022, GDPR, and PCI DSS—specifically SAQ A-EP. These are reported as public compliance claims, not as equivalent forms of certification. | compliance_certs.0: https://trust.octopus.com/ names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: https://trust.octopus.com/ names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.2: https://trust.octopus.com/ names GDPR as a compliance claim. | compliance_certs.3: https://trust.octopus.com/ names PCI DSS with the specific scope SAQ A-EP.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/531a7edee4b0f7e166107d0e/octopus%20deploy#a:about labels the October 8, 2025 latest funding round Series B. The stage designation is supported by a third-party funding profile. | funding_date: The latest-round profile at https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/531a7edee4b0f7e166107d0e/octopus%20deploy#a:about gives October 8, 2025, yielding 2025-10. The contemporaneous report at https://www.techinasia.com/news/insight-partners-leads-30m-australian-software-firm is dated the same day. | funding_amount_usd: The latest-round profile at https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/531a7edee4b0f7e166107d0e/octopus%20deploy#a:about reports US$30 million. The October 8, 2025 report at https://www.techinasia.com/news/insight-partners-leads-30m-australian-software-firm independently reports the same amount from Insight Partners.

raised_18mo.notes: https://www.techinasia.com/news/insight-partners-leads-30m-australian-software-firm reports a US$30 million investment on October 8, 2025, inside the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current application board at https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/octopusdeploy lists only revenue-systems roles and expressions of interest, with no SDR, BDR, or account executive opening. Although http://octopus.com/careers retains sales-role links, the checked Strategic Account Executive URL, http://octopus.com/company/careers/4000924201, renders the generic homepage rather than a live posting. The current application board is therefore preferred.

launched_6mo.notes: https://octopus.com/blog/feature-flags-public-preview announces Feature Flags public preview for Octopus Cloud customers on July 13, 2026, within the six-month window. The feature controls when and where functionality is enabled without redeployment.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: https://www.theofficialboard.com/news/octopus-deploy reports that Chief Revenue Officer Harsh Sabikhi left the company, with the movement posted July 21, 2026—inside the requested 12-month window. The source is a third-party executive-movement tracker.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/octopusdeploy/jobs/4008758201 explicitly describes ownership of HubSpot and a migration from Salesforce to HubSpot. This establishes HubSpot as the destination platform and Salesforce as the system being migrated away from. | crm_stack_signal.0: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/octopusdeploy/jobs/4008758201 states that IT Operations owns HubSpot and is making it central to the revenue stack. | crm_stack_signal.1: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/octopusdeploy/jobs/4008758201 explicitly describes a migration from Salesforce to HubSpot; Salesforce is a migration-source signal, not the stated destination system.
